meta.title: FarmXYZ — Next-generation smart farm management
meta.description: Thermal imaging, digital tracking for poultry and cattle, and AI-powered farm management — on one platform.

hero.subtitle: Thermal imaging, digital livestock tracking and AI-powered farm management. Catch illness before it spreads and keep track of every bird and cow on one platform.

visual.label: Live thermal camera view of a poultry shed, with one bird flagged for high body temperature

technology.title: Three layers of intelligence for your farm
technology.description: Cameras, sensors and software working together, so you decide with data instead of guesswork.

thermal.title: Spot sickness from body heat
thermal.description: Thermal cameras scan every bird's body temperature and alert you the moment signs of fever or heat stress appear.

tracking.title: A digital identity for every animal
tracking.description: Smart tags and GPS collars keep each cow's, or each flock's, location, movement and health history in one place.

platform.title: Your whole farm on one dashboard
platform.description: Feed, vaccinations, mortality, sales and costs — every number in real time, right from your phone.

poultry.title: Catch fever before symptoms show
poultry.description: A sick bird's body temperature usually rises before visible symptoms appear. Our AI analyses the heat map of every shed around the clock to find abnormal changes.

points.perBird: Temperature detection for every individual bird
points.alerts: Instant alerts on your phone, in Bangla or English

visual.label: 24-hour chart of average body temperature, showing an abnormal rise in the evening

cattle.title: Know where every cow is, and how it's doing
cattle.description: GPS collars and smart ear tags record each cow's location, movement, rumination and rest. If an animal leaves its zone or its behaviour changes, you know right away.

points.signals: Early signals for heat (oestrus) and illness
points.history: Complete health and vaccination history per animal

meta.title: User guide
meta.description: Step-by-step help for FarmXYZ: sign up, subscribe with bKash, add farms and batches, record feed, mortality, weight and sales, and read your profit and loss.

guide.title: How to use FarmXYZ
guide.subtitle: Everything you need to run your broiler farm in FarmXYZ, from your first login to your profit and loss report. Pick a topic or read from the top.

gettingStarted.title: Get started
gettingStarted.intro: FarmXYZ works in the browser on your phone or computer. There's nothing to install.

signup.title: Create an account
signup.body: Tap Get started and enter your full name, mobile number and a password. No SMS code is needed.

login.title: Log in
login.body: Next time, log in with the same mobile number and password. Your mobile number is your login.

preferences.title: Choose language and theme
preferences.body: Use the language button to switch between Bangla and English, and the sun/moon button for light or dark mode.

install.title: Add it to your home screen
install.body: On your phone, open the browser menu and choose "Add to Home screen" to open FarmXYZ like an app.

gettingStarted.tip: Forgot your password? Contact support to reset it. Your mobile number can't be changed.

subscription.title: Subscription and payment
subscription.intro: Signing up is free and you can always see your data. To add or edit farms, batches and records you need an active subscription.

readOnly.title: Read-only mode
readOnly.body: Without a subscription, a banner says you're in read-only mode. Everything you've already entered stays visible.

pay.title: Pay with bKash
pay.body: Tap Subscribe and send the monthly fee with bKash Send Money to the number shown.

request.title: Send the request
request.body: Enter the last {digits} digits of the number you paid from and tap "I've paid — send request".

approval.title: Wait for approval
approval.body: Once we match your payment, adding and editing is turned on. If a request is rejected, check the digits and try again.

renew.title: Renew on time
renew.body: A reminder appears {days} days before your subscription ends. Pay again before then to keep working without a break.

subscription.tip: Your subscription includes {included} farms. Each extra farm adds a monthly fee. You'll see the new amount before you add the farm, and the fee goes down again if you delete it.

farms.title: Farms
farms.intro: A farm is a shed or site you run. Each farm holds its batches and its own costs.

add.title: Add a farm
add.body: Go to Farms and tap Add farm. Enter a name and the address (village, upazila, district).

open.title: Open a farm
open.body: Tap a farm to see its batches, its farm expenses and its profit and loss.

farmExpenses.title: Farm expenses
farmExpenses.body: Costs that don't belong to one batch, like rent or a new feeder, go under Farm expenses.

delete.title: Delete a farm
delete.body: Delete the farm's batches and expenses first. Then the farm itself can be deleted.

batches.title: Batches
batches.intro: A batch is one flock of chicks, from the day they're placed until they're sold.

create.title: Start a batch
create.body: Open a farm and tap New batch. Enter a name, the breed, the start date and the number of chicks placed.

stats.title: Read the numbers
stats.body: The batch page shows age, birds alive, mortality, feed used, latest average weight, FCR, expenses and profit. They update as you add records.

status.title: Close the batch
status.body: When the flock is sold, edit the batch and set the status to Completed. Use Cancelled for a batch that didn't go ahead.

dashboard.title: Check the dashboard
dashboard.body: The Dashboard lists the active batches of all your farms, so you can see everything at a glance.

records.title: Daily records
records.intro: Records are what make the numbers work. Add them on the batch page under Records. A few minutes a day is enough.

feeds.title: Feed
feeds.body: How much feed the flock ate. Used for feed used and FCR.

mortalities.title: Mortality
mortalities.body: How many birds died and why. Keeps the live count and mortality rate correct.

weights.title: Weight
weights.body: Weigh a sample of birds and enter the average weight and how many you weighed. Used for growth charts and FCR.

medicines.title: Medicine
medicines.body: Vaccines and treatments, with the dose and the disease they're for.

expenses.title: Expenses
expenses.body: Money spent on the batch: chicks, feed, medicine, labour, electricity, transport and more.

sales.title: Sales
sales.body: Birds sold, total weight, price per kg and buyer. The total is worked out for you, and sold birds leave the live count.

records.tip: Add the cost of chicks and feed as expenses too. Otherwise your profit will look higher than it really is.

reports.title: Charts and profit & loss
reports.intro: FarmXYZ turns your records into charts and a profit and loss report, so you know how each batch really did.

charts.title: Batch charts
charts.body: On a batch, open Charts to follow feed, mortality and weight over the life of the flock.

batch.title: Batch profit & loss
batch.body: Open Profit & loss on a batch to see sales minus expenses and where the money went.

farm.title: Farm and overall reports
farm.body: A farm's report adds up all its batches plus farm expenses. The Dashboard shows the total for all your farms.

whatIf.title: Try a what-if
whatIf.body: Untick a batch or an expense category to see the result without it. Tap Include everything to go back.

contacts.title: Contacts
contacts.intro: Keep your suppliers, buyers, vets and workers in one place.

add.title: Add a contact
add.body: Go to Contacts, tap Add contact, and enter the name, phone number and type.

types.title: Set the type
types.body: Only contacts marked as Buyer appear when you record a sale. Any contact can be picked as Paid to on an expense.

delete.title: Delete a contact
delete.body: Deleting a contact doesn't delete the records that mention them.

account.title: Your account
account.intro: Check your subscription and keep your profile up to date.

profile.title: Profile
profile.body: Change your name or password on the Account page. Your mobile number is your login and can't be changed.

subscription.title: Subscription status
subscription.body: See whether you can add records and until when, your monthly fee, and your last payment request.

logout.title: Log out
logout.body: Open the user menu at the top right and tap Log out. Always do this on a shared phone.

fcr.question: What is FCR?
fcr.answer: Feed conversion ratio: kg of feed eaten ÷ kg of live weight produced. Lower is better. Live weight is the weight already sold plus birds still alive × the latest average weight, so add weight samples regularly.

mortality.question: How is mortality calculated?
mortality.answer: Birds that died ÷ chicks placed, shown as a percentage.

deleteBatch.question: Why can't I delete a batch?
deleteBatch.answer: A batch that has records can't be deleted, so data isn't lost by mistake. Delete its records first, or set the batch to Cancelled.

privacy.question: Can other people see my farm data?
privacy.answer: No. Your farms, batches and records are linked to your account, and other users can't see them.

devices.question: Can I use FarmXYZ on more than one device?
devices.answer: Yes. Log in with the same mobile number on any phone or computer and you'll see the same data.

password.question: I forgot my password. What now?
password.answer: Contact support and we'll reset it. Your mobile number stays the same. If you're still logged in, you can set a new one yourself under Account → Change password.

cta.title: Ready to start?
cta.description: Signing up is free. Add your first farm in under a minute.
